title: Prevent admitted bootstrap readers from failing during concurrent dist promotion
description: User-authorized narrow follow-up to B-1734 on 2026-09-06. Reuse these tests instead of rediscovering the bug, but adapt and rerun them against the final production implementation for fresh verificationEvidence. Acceptance: preserve coherent initial imports during promotion, stable and builder-first startup, genuine missing-artifact fail-closed behavior, and dependency-missing fresh-checkout diagnostics without importing unavailable proper-lockfile. Decide the smallest production-safe coordination at PLAN; the experimental mutex candidate is not a mandated production design. Exclude B-1734 zombie lifecycle cleanup, global CLI executable/symlink ownership (B-e256), all direct dist consumers, full F-032 reviewer credential contamination, source-edit-during-compile binding, package-desktop locking, rename-crash recovery and repository-wide green cleanup unless evidence establishes a direct acceptance/protected-surface blocker.
